name: Fathom Call Notes: Slack recap and Notion CRM notes (TEMPLATE)

parameters.content:
# Setup
**Accounts you need:** Fathom (a plan with webhooks), Notion, Slack, OpenAI.

**1. Notion CRM.** One database for clients with: Name (title), Email (email), Status (status, with options Meeting Booked and Pitching), Project Name (text). Each client page needs an inline database titled exactly **Meetings** with Name (title) and Date (date). Share the CRM with your Notion integration.

**2. Replace placeholders.**
**Check CRM:** YOUR_NOTION_CRM_DATABASE_ID (the 32 character id in the database link).
**Send Summary, No CRM Match Alert, Slack: moved to Pitching:** YOUR_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID.
**Set Client email:** YOUR_EMAIL, YOUR_NAME, YOUR_COMPANY_DOMAIN, so you are never matched as the client.
**Generate Summary - Slack** (system message): YOUR_NAME, so recaps are titled after the guest.

**3. Connect credentials.**
Notion API on Check CRM, Get Page Blocks, Create Meeting Page and CRM: Meeting Booked -> Pitching.
Slack API (bot token with chat:write, bot invited to the channel) on the three Slack nodes.
OpenAI API on OpenAI Chat Model2.

**4. Point Fathom at it.** Activate, copy the production URL `https://YOUR_N8N_HOST/webhook/fathom/call-complete`, then in Fathom (Settings, API Access) add a webhook to it with transcript, summary and action items included.

Anyone who knows this URL can post to it. Keep it private, or add a check of Fathom's webhook signature right after the Fathom node.

## Post Call: Meeting Summary
Turns the Fathom transcript into a Slack recap and adds meeting notes to the client's page in your Notion CRM.

**Matching:** invitee email first, then an unambiguous transcript speaker name (impromptu calls have no invitees). Zero or ambiguous matches go to **No CRM Match Alert** in Slack instead of silently skipping Notion.

## CRM status: Meeting Booked to Pitching
Only fires when the matched CRM row is sitting in Meeting Booked AND someone other than you actually talked (5 or more transcript segments), so a no-show never advances the deal. Every other status is left alone.
